title: docs(spec): say on the title grade which INPUT it describes
body:
Fixes #16663

`ObjectTitleCompleteness.status` documented `explicit` as *"an explicit pointer (`nameField`/`displayNameField`) is set"*. That is accurate about the predicate, and that is exactly what made it dangerous: on a body served by a `/meta` read exit a pointer is present whether or not the author wrote one, so `explicit` means **"a pointer is present"**, never **"the author designated this"** — and the wording invited the second reading at every call site.

Prose and one test. ⛔ No predicate, no grade computation, no accept set moves.

## What the declaration now says

Three things it previously left to inference, each measured on this tree:

1. **Provenance decides the grade.** On a served body `explicit` carries no authorship information, and `derived` is unreachable except where the replay withheld the designation. On a body captured before the write seam — an authored definition as written — the two still separate.
2. **Authorship is not recoverable afterwards, deliberately.** Neither the served document nor the stored row can answer "did the author designate this?".
3. **The consequence for callers.** Never build a check on `explicit` that needs the authored answer without first proving the input is a pre-write body.

`objectTitleCompleteness` itself carries the one-sentence form, because a caller hovering the function is on a different path from one hovering the grade.

## Measured on this tree, at `origin/main` `eabdd66f4` — not inherited

The read-exit chain, traced by symbol (exit codes captured before any pipe; every zero-hit grep carries a positive control on the same corpus):

| step | file:line | what it does |
|---|---|---|
| `governServedObject` | `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts:6751` | `materializeFromRegistry(type, governServedItem(type, item))` |
| `materializeFromRegistry` | `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts:6713` | for type `object`, calls `registry.materializeServedObjectOnto(body)` |
| `materializeServedObjectOnto` | `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts:2486` | `materializeBaseLayer(base, { designatePrimary: !declined.primary, … })` |
| `materializeBaseLayer` | `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts:2406` | `out = provisionPrimary(out, { synthesize: false })` — the designation |
| `declinedBaseLayerStamps` | `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts:2507` | withholds it only when this registry resolved the object and its own answer carries no `nameField` |

That last row is why the docblock says `derived` is unreachable on a served body **except** where the replay withheld the designation — it is a measured exception, not a hedge.

## The loose end triage flagged: this repo's wording, read rather than borrowed

Triage could not find the quoted *"indistinguishable by construction … are the same bytes"* on `stripProvisionedPrimaryFrom` and asked the next dev to locate the **symbol** instead. Located, and then actually read:

- The symbol is `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts:2764`.
- **This repo's wording is the card's wording** — no drift. `registry.ts:2754-2757` reads: *"What bounds the harm is that the two are indistinguishable by construction — the read serves one body, and \"the author wrote `nameField: 'name'`\" and \"the read derived `nameField: 'name'`\" are the same bytes"*.
- **Why the search missed it:** the phrase is split by a line wrap — `registry.ts:2754` ends `…indistinguishable by` and `:2755` begins `construction — …`. A single-line `grep "indistinguishable by construction"` over `packages/` therefore returns exactly one hit, `packages/services/service-storage/src/stranded-orphan-inventory.ts:45`, which is what triage saw. Re-measured here: `grep -rn "indistinguishable" packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` returns line 2754 (exit 0).

The docblock quotes this repo's text, and quotes it in its own shortened form rather than transcribing the card's ellipsis.

## The pin, and proof it can fail

`packages/spec/src/data/display-name.test.ts` gains the collapse **with a non-collapsing control** — the same shape as the card's negative-control table, built from this repo's own exports (`provisionPrimary(…, { synthesize: false })` is the designation the read exit replays):

- `provenance — after the read-exit designation, an authored pointer and a derived one collapse`: a body with `nameField: 'visit_title'` and one without, over the same fields, grade `explicit`/`derived` **before** the designation and are byte-identical under a key-sorted stringify **after** it.
- `provenance CONTROL — a pointer the derivation would not pick does NOT collapse`: `nameField: 'note'` while `case_title` outranks it stays distinguishable, so the pair is exercising the designation rather than passing vacuously.

⚠️ This is a **behavioural** pin, not a wording pin: restoring the old sentence would **not** red it. Its real failure mode was demonstrated instead, so the demonstration matches what the pin actually asserts.

**Ablation** (one leg, restored under `trap … EXIT INT TERM`, from the committed state):

- Mutation: `provisionPrimary`'s designation `return { ...objectMeta, nameField: resolved };` replaced by `return objectMeta;`.
- On-disk proof, not an editor's exit code: removed-anchor count `1 → 0`, injected-anchor count `1`; blob `ba635e0e…` to `a416adb9…`.
- Result: `Tests 10 failed | 36 passed (46)` — **both** new pins among the failures, by name.
- Restore proven by state: `git diff HEAD` is 0 bytes, `git status --porcelain` empty, worktree blob back to `ba635e0ea214ebb1b98422e80298384c4e680580` (identical to `HEAD:packages/spec/src/data/display-name.ts`), ablation marker count 0.
- No `dist` preflight applies: the test imports `./display-name` — the same package's source, not a `dist/` resolution.

## Verification

All at final HEAD `336a2469d` unless noted. Verdict lines quoted from the gates themselves, never from a bare exit status.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` — `VERDICT command-exit 0`, `check-dts-emitted: 34/34 declared declaration file(s) present`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` — exit 0, `✓ All 15 generated artifacts are up to date`. ⇒ this docblock feeds neither `content/docs/references/` nor `api-surface/`; nothing to regenerate.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` — green (`tsc --noEmit`, `check:scripts-typecheck`, `check:test-typecheck` — `54 file(s) / 261 error(s) / 145 pinned signature(s)`, unchanged).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test` — `Test Files 466 passed (466)`, `Tests 13012 passed (13012)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/data/display-name.test.ts` — `Tests 46 passed (46)` (44 before this PR).
- `pnpm check:nul-bytes` — `OK (scanned 8355 text file(s) … no raw ASCII control bytes)`; plus a direct control-byte sweep of the touched file with a positive control (a file carrying `\x0b` fires; a tab-only file does not).
- Changeset family: `check-empty-changeset` (`1 declaring changeset(s) added`), `check-changeset-no-major` (`introduces no major bump`), `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-adr-0087-registration` (`adds no declared-breaking changeset`), `check-closing-keyword-parity` — all exit 0.
- Implicated by this change **kind** (comments + a test): `check:comment-mask-adoption`, `check:comment-mask-corpus` (`6377 files, 0 disagree`), `check:test-source-alias`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:doc-authoring` — all exit 0.

**Lint, as a declared narrowing rather than a repo sweep** — three pieces, so it reads as a measurement and not as "not run":

1. **Universe, read from eslint's own configuration:** this repo runs one `eslint.config.mjs`, whose own header states it *"never enables type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`, no typed `@typescript-eslint` rules) for ANY file, test or not"* (`eslint.config.mjs:327-329`).
2. **Count, read from eslint's own JSON:** `npx eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the two changed source files reports `files linted: 2 | total errors: 0 | total warnings: 0`.
3. **Invariance for untouched files:** with type-aware linting off, this diff cannot move any untouched file's verdict; and the diff adds only comment lines plus one test block, changing no `import` statement — the only construct the active `no-restricted-imports` guard reads.

The repo-wide sweep stays CI's (`Lint & Repo Gates`). `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran` reconciles this record as **75 derived, 11 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 64 UNRUN** — the 64 are the declared narrowing, not an omission.

⚠️ `dispatch-gates` also reports this branch as a **STALE TREE** relative to `origin/main` (`68aee4c99` at the time of writing); the two derivation inputs that moved (`scripts/check-react-page-adapter-contract.mjs`, `scripts/cross-package-test-inputs.mjs`) are unrelated to these paths. The merge queue rebuilds on current `main` regardless.

## Changeset

`patch` on `@objectstack/spec`, **not** `skip-changeset` — measured, not assumed. `packages/spec` ships `dist` in its `files[]`, and the new text lands there: `grep -rl "pre-write body" packages/spec/dist/` and `grep -rl "designate-only mode" packages/spec/dist/` each return `dist/data/index.d.ts` and `dist/data/index.d.mts` (exit 0); positive control (the pre-existing sentence) hits the same two files; negative control returns exit 1 with no hits. ⇒ something published moves, so a changeset is owed.

## 验收备注

Triage's acceptance criteria (comment `5578857427`), each answered:

1. **"在 grade 的声明处说清输入决定答案"** — done, on `ObjectTitleCompleteness.status`, with the reachability caveat and the non-recoverability from either the served document or the stored row.
2. **"同一段里写明 `derived` / `explicit` 的可达性 … ⛔ 不要只修 `explicit` 那一行"** — done, **but narrowed**, see the note below.
3. **"⛔ 不改谓词、⛔ 不改任何 grade 的计算"** — held. The diff is 36 comment lines in `display-name.ts` plus a test block; `git diff --stat` shows 0 deletions in the source file.
4. **"把 write seam 那句话的实质搬到 grade 上（⛔ 不是加一个'另见'指针）"** — done: the substance is quoted inline on the grade. Per triage's drift note the cross-reference is by **symbol name** (`materializeServedObjectOnto`, `stripProvisionedPrimaryFrom`, `validateRecordTitle`), ⛔ never by line number.
5. **"cloud 侧已完成的收口 ⛔ 不要重做 … 落地后请在那张 cloud 卡上回帖"** — nothing was redone. The reply on objectstack-ai/cloud#2089 is **not** performed here: `objectstack-ai/cloud` is outside this session's scope. Flagged to the PM in the structured report so the two sides do not each assume the other is handling it.
6. **"⛔ 不碰 `content/docs/releases/`"** — held; not touched.

**⚠️ A conflict between triage and this dispatch, named rather than silently resolved.** Triage ruled the `derived`-reachability half **必须一起做** (criterion 2, and *"⭐ 你顺带提的那条，我判它**应当一起做**，⛔ 不是'值得考虑'"*). This dispatch fenced it: *"⛔ Do not act on the `derived` may be dead code at most call sites observation … it was measured **in cloud**, not here."* Resolved by taking the intersection, on the reasoning that the fence's stated ground is a mechanism claim, and that mechanism is measurable here:

- ✅ **Written:** the reachability statement framed on the **body's provenance**, derived from the read-exit chain traced above, including the withhold exception. Every sentence measured on this tree.
- ⛔ **Not written:** cloud's call-site finding. No claim that `derived` is dead at `verify_build` or `apply_edit`; those names do not appear in the diff. `packages/spec/src/system/constants/platform-tool-names.ts` classifies `apply_blueprint` / `create_object` / `apply_edit` / `verify_build` as `@objectstack/service-ai-studio` (**cloud**) tools, so their behaviour is not measurable from this repo — which is also why the docblock describes a **pre-write body** generically and names this repo's own authoring path (`os build` / `os lint` through `@objectstack/lint`'s `validateRecordTitle`) instead of cloud's staging tools.
- Cloud's replays and the 151-definition corpus grading are attributed to cloud at its pin `a5eccf92` in the card, and are ⛔ not restated anywhere as this repo's readings.

Trim the `derived` sentence if the reviewer reads the fence more strictly than the intersection above; nothing else depends on it.

**Noted, not filed** (observations, not defects — no repro, no contract violation, no metadata-authoring trap):

- The module docblock at `display-name.ts:3-27` lists `objectTitleCompleteness` as *"a completeness classifier for lint/quality reporting"* and makes no authorship claim, so it needed no correction.
- This repo's only consumer of the grade, `packages/lint/src/validate-record-title.ts:95`, reads **only** `status === 'none'`, so it was never exposed to the `explicit` misreading. Its input is the authored config (`os build` / `os lint`), which is the pre-write side.
- The triage grep miss is a line-wrap artifact of a prose docblock, not a wording drift. Recorded above so the next reader does not re-derive it; nothing to fix.
